alt: A list of numbers scanned once, left to right, with a pointer on the current number. Beside it, a two-cell array holds the running min_val and max_val, updating only when the current number beats one of them.

steps.caption: Before the loop, both running values start at the first number, 1.
2 is a new high. max_val rises from 1 to 2.
3 is a new high. max_val rises from 2 to 3.
4 is a new high. max_val rises from 3 to 4.
5 is a new high. max_val rises from 4 to 5.
After one pass over all 5 numbers, min_val is 1 and max_val is 5.
Before the loop, both running values start at the first number, 5.
4 beats the running min of 5. min_val drops to 4.
3 beats the running min of 4. min_val drops to 3.
2 beats the running min of 3. min_val drops to 2.
1 beats the running min of 2. min_val drops to 1.
After one pass over all 5 numbers, min_val is 1 and max_val is 5.
Before the loop, both running values start at the first number, 7.
After one pass over all 1 number, min_val is 7 and max_val is 7.
